# Taxonomy of Grid-Based Logic Puzzles

## I. By Primary Task Type

### A. Loop/Path Drawing
Puzzles where the solver draws a single continuous loop or path through the grid.

#### A1. Pure Loop Construction
- **Masyu** — Loop through circles with straight/turn constraints
- **Slitherlink** — Loop on grid edges guided by number clues
- **Mid-loop** — Loop where black circles are midpoints of straight segments
- **Nagareru** — Directed loop with wind constraints
- **Suraromu** — Loop passing through numbered gates in order
- **Moon-or-Sun** — Loop alternating between moon/sun rooms

#### A2. Loop with Region Interaction
- **Dotchi-Loop** — Loop through regions where white circles are all-straight or all-turn per region
- **Yajilin** — Loop with placed black cells guided by directional number clues

#### A3. Path/Connection Drawing
- **Numberlink** — Connect pairs of identical numbers with non-crossing paths
- **Hashiwokakero** — Connect islands with bridges (1 or 2) to form a connected network

### B. Cell Shading / Painting
Puzzles where the solver colors certain cells black (or leaves them white).

#### B1. Shading with Number Constraints (counts of adjacent/nearby black cells)
- **Kurotto** — Numbers in circles indicate sum of contiguous black groups touching them
- **Akari** — Place light bulbs that illuminate rows/columns; numbers on black cells constrain adjacent bulb count
- **Usowan** — Numbers show adjacent black cell count, but one number per region is wrong
- **Nurikabe** — Numbers define white island sizes; black cells form one connected wall with no 2×2

#### B2. Shading with Connectivity/Shape Constraints
- **Heyawake** — Rooms with black cell counts; white cells connected, no white line spans 3+ rooms
- **Norinori** — Exactly two black cells per region, each black cell part of a domino
- **LITS** — Place one tetromino per region; all shaded cells connected; no matching adjacent tetrominoes
- **Kurodoko** — Numbers indicate visible white cell count in four directions; black cells non-adjacent and white cells connected
- **Nurimisaki** — Circle cells are white "promontories" (one white neighbor); no 2×2 of same color
- **Nuritwin** — Each region has exactly two same-sized shaded blocks; all shaded cells globally connected
- **Hitori** — Shade duplicate numbers so no repeats per row/column; black cells non-adjacent; white cells connected
- **Nurimeizu** — Shade entire rooms to create a maze from S to G with shortest-path constraints

#### B3. Shading with Geometric Shape Constraints
- **Choco Banana** — Black groups must be rectangles; white groups must not be rectangles; numbers indicate group size
- **Shakashaka** — Place triangles so remaining white areas form rectangles/squares
- **Tilepaint** — Color entire tiles to match row/column black-cell counts given at diagonal cells
- **Sto-stone** — Shade cells in rooms; when "dropped" by gravity, they fill exactly the bottom half of the grid

### C. Region Division / Partitioning
Puzzles where the solver divides the grid into regions or blocks.

#### C1. Partition into Specified Shapes
- **Shikaku** — Divide grid into rectangles, each containing exactly one number equal to its area
- **Five Cells** — Divide grid into pentominoes; numbers indicate surrounding block-edge count
- **Sashigane** — Divide grid into L-shaped blocks guided by circles (knees) and arrows (ends)

#### C2. Partition with Matching/Symmetry Constraints
- **Double Choco** — Divide into blocks where each block's white region and gray region have the same shape

### D. Number Placement / Filling
Puzzles where the solver fills cells with numbers.

#### D1. Latin-Square Variants
- **Sudoku** — Place 1–9 in rows, columns, and 3×3 boxes without repetition

#### D2. Region-Based Number Filling
- **Fillomino** — Fill numbers forming polyomino blocks of that size; same-sized blocks non-adjacent
- **Ripple Effect** — Fill rooms with 1 to N; repeated numbers in a line must be spaced apart ≥ the number's value
- **Makaro** — Fill rooms with 1 to N; arrows in black cells point to the largest adjacent number; no same number adjacent across rooms
- **Nansuke** — Place given multi-digit numbers into a crossword-style grid

### E. Object Placement
Puzzles where the solver places specific objects into the grid.

- **Akari** — Place light bulbs in white cells (also fits B1 due to illumination shading)
- **Evolomino** — Place growing polyomino blocks along arrow paths
- **Pencils** — Identify pencil shapes and draw lines from their tips
- **Juosan** — Fill every cell with a horizontal (—) or vertical (|) mark under continuity limits

### F. Movement / Rearrangement
Puzzles where existing objects are moved to satisfy constraints.

- **Satogaeri** — Move circles within grid so each region has exactly one; numbers specify distance moved
- **Yosenabe** — Move circles straight into gray areas; numbers in gray areas must match the sum of entering circles

---

## II. By Constraint Mechanism

### Numeric Clues
| Constraint Type | Puzzles |
|---|---|
| **Adjacent count** | Akari, Kurotto, Usowan, Shakashaka, Slitherlink, Five Cells |
| **Visible/line-of-sight count** | Kurodoko, Akari (illumination), Nurimisaki, Yajilin |
| **Region sum/size** | Shikaku, Fillomino, Choco Banana, Nurikabe, Nuritwin, Heyawake, Makaro, Ripple Effect, Double Choco, Sto-stone |
| **Distance/movement** | Satogaeri, Yosenabe |
| **Sequence/ordering** | Hebi, Suraromu, Evolomino, Moon-or-Sun |

### Connectivity Constraints
| Constraint | Puzzles |
|---|---|
| **All white cells connected** | Hitori, Kurodoko, Heyawake, Nurimisaki, Nurikabe, Usowan |
| **All shaded cells connected** | LITS, Nuritwin |
| **Single loop** | Masyu, Slitherlink, Mid-loop, Nagareru, Suraromu, Yajilin, Dotchi-Loop, Moon-or-Sun |
| **Connected bridge network** | Hashiwokakero |
| **Connected chain of blocks** | Chained Block |

### Non-adjacency / Separation Constraints
| Constraint | Puzzles |
|---|---|
| **Black cells non-adjacent** | Kurodoko, Hitori, Yajilin, Usowan |
| **No 2×2 black** | Nurikabe, LITS, Nurimisaki, Nurimeizu, Sto-stone |
| **No 2×2 white** | Nurimisaki, Nurimeizu |
| **Same-sized blocks non-adjacent** | Fillomino |
| **Same-shaped tetrominoes non-adjacent** | LITS |
| **Same number non-adjacent across rooms** | Makaro |

### Shape Constraints
| Constraint | Puzzles |
|---|---|
| **Must form rectangles/squares** | Choco Banana (black), Shakashaka (white), Shikaku |
| **Must NOT form rectangles** | Choco Banana (white) |
| **Must form L-shapes** | Sashigane |
| **Must form tetrominoes** | LITS |
| **Must form pentominoes** | Five Cells |
| **Matching shape pairs** | Double Choco, Nuritwin |
| **Progressive/evolving shapes** | Evolomino |

---

## III. By Information Type Given in the Puzzle

### A. Grid starts mostly empty
- Sudoku, Fillomino, Ripple Effect, Makaro, Nansuke, Juosan

### B. Grid has pre-placed symbols (circles, arrows, numbers on black cells)
- Masyu, Akari, Kurotto, Mid-loop, Dotchi-Loop, Sashigane, Pencils, Evolomino, Moon-or-Sun, Hebi, Nagareru

### C. Grid has pre-defined regions (bold-line bordered)
- Heyawake, Norinori, LITS, Double Choco, Makaro, Ripple Effect, Five Cells, Nurimeizu, Nurimisaki, Moon-or-Sun, Dotchi-Loop, Nuritwin, Chained Block, Satogaeri, Sto-stone, Suraromu, Tilepaint, Usowan

### D. Grid has pre-placed numbers only (no regions beyond standard)
- Hitori, Kurodoko, Nurikabe, Numberlink, Slitherlink, Hashiwokakero, Yajilin, Shikaku, Fillomino, Choco Banana, Yosenabe

---

## IV. Summary Tree

```
Grid-Based Logic Puzzles
├── DRAW (loops, paths, connections)
│   ├── Single Loop
│   │   ├── Edge-based: Slitherlink
│   │   └── Cell-center-based
│   │       ├── Symbol-constrained: Masyu, Mid-loop, Dotchi-Loop
│   │       ├── Direction-constrained: Nagareru
│   │       ├── Region-constrained: Moon-or-Sun, Suraromu
│   │       └── With black cell placement: Yajilin
│   ├── Paths/Connections
│   │   ├── Pair connections: Numberlink
│   │   └── Bridge networks: Hashiwokakero
│   └── Lines from objects: Pencils
│
├── SHADE (color cells black or white)
│   ├── Number-guided shading
│   │   ├── Adjacent counts: Akari, Kurotto, Usowan
│   │   ├── Directional counts: Kurodoko, Yajilin
│   │   └── Region counts: Heyawake, Nurikabe, Sto-stone, Nuritwin
│   ├── Shape-constrained shading
│   │   ├── Rectangles required: Choco Banana, Shakashaka
│   │   ├── Tetrominoes: LITS
│   │   └── Dominoes: Norinori
│   ├── Elimination shading: Hitori
│   └── Maze creation: Nurimeizu
│
├── DIVIDE (partition grid into regions)
│   ├── Into rectangles: Shikaku
│   ├── Into pentominoes: Five Cells
│   ├── Into L-shapes: Sashigane
│   ├── Into matched-pair blocks: Double Choco
│   └── Into numbered polyominoes: Fillomino
│
├── FILL (place numbers or symbols)
│   ├── Complete number grid: Sudoku, Fillomino, Ripple Effect, Makaro
│   ├── Place number words: Nansuke
│   ├── Place orientation marks: Juosan
│   ├── Place sequential numbers: Hebi
│   └── Place evolving shapes: Evolomino
│
├── PLACE (objects into grid)
│   ├── Light bulbs: Akari
│   └── Black cell blocks: Chained Block, Choco Banana
│
└── MOVE (rearrange existing objects)
    ├── Move circles to regions: Satogaeri
    └── Move circles into gray areas: Yosenabe
```
